description: Case 08 with an extra search result: the encyclopedia page about the book itself. It is about Alice, but it is not an outside essay offering a lens on identity, so it must not appear on the shortlist.

input.cue: Can you recommend an outside essay that offers a lens on Alice's uncertainty about identity?
